title: tune-nccl-streams-scheduling-kernel-sync-tensor-parallel-collectives
author: Samir Patel
description: Motivation: In multi-GPU tensor-parallel serving workloads we observed head-of-line stalls and underutilized compute due to suboptimal ordering and synchronization between NCCL collectives and CUDA kernels. This PR changes the NCCL scheduling and kernel sync points to increase overlap between communication and compute while avoiding race conditions in KV cache hot-paths and continuous-batching.
commits: implement nccl stream manager and per-collective priority assignment
add cudaStreamWaitEvent barriers for ordered kernel/collective overlap
adjust kernel launch points to allow asynchronous all-reduce during feed-forward
kv cache prefetch gating to avoid cross-GPU stalls
add runtime flag enable_nccl_overlap and config plumbing
add integration tests for tp nccl overlap and deterministic seeds
fix flaky distributed pytest by increasing collective timeout and deterministic ordering
docs: add performance notes and rollout guidance
